riff.description: riff accents (notes marked '>' on accent_lane tracks); pitch = lowest note

melody.description: melody notes; pitch = MIDI note, dur/durBeats = length, bend = semitones

shouts.description: gang shouts; `word` = HEY/WHOA/HO/HA/YEAH; t = vowel onset

stops.description: band stops/breaks: silence from t for dur seconds (reverb tails ring)
